description: This file defines the Upload controller for handling file uploads in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes validation of upload tokens, filename sanitization, file type and MIME validation, and moves the uploaded file to a designated directory, then registers the upload via a model.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling file upload requests, including validation and storage.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to process the upload request, validate, and store the uploaded file, returning a JSON response.
